questions.question:
What is the value of the given expression? 

(a + b + c)² - a² - b² - c²
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

**Calculation:**

(a + b + c)2 - a2 - b2 - c2

⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca) - a2 - b2 - c2

⇒ 2(ab + bc + ca)

**∴ The correct answer is 2(ab + bc + ca).**

questions.question: After allowing a discount of 15%, the value of a washing machine is Rs. 29,750. If no discount is allowed, then the shopkeeper gains 12%. The cost price of the washing machine is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (S.P) = Rs.29750

Discount (D%) = 15%

**Concept used:**

Discount (D)% = X%

Marked price (M.P) : Selling price (S.P) = 100 : (100 - X%)

Profit (P)% = Y%

Cost price (C.P) : Selling price (S.P) = 100 : (100 + Y%)

**Calculation:**

Discount (D%) = 15%

M.P : S.P = 100 : 85 = 20 : 17

⇒ 17 units = 29750

⇒ 1 unit = 29750/17 = Rs.1750

Marked price (M.P) = 20 units = 20 × 1750 = 35000

Now, if the discount is not given new S.P = M.P

Profit = 12%

C.P : S.P = 100 : 112 = 25 : 28

⇒ 28 units = 35000

⇒ 1 unit = (35000/28) = Rs.1250

Cost price (C.P) = 25 units = 1250 × 25 = Rs.31250

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.31250.**

questions.question: One quality of rice at Rs. 45 per kg is mixed with another quality at a certain rate in the ratio of 3 ∶ 2. If the mixture so formed is worth Rs. 50 per kg, what is the rate per kg of the second quality of rice?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate of the first type of rice = Rs.45/kg

Rate of the mixture of rice = Rs.50/kg

**Formula used:**

Average rate of product = Total price of product/quantity of product

**Calculation:**

Let rice of first type of rice = 3x

Rice of second type of rice = 2x

Rate of second type of rice = Rs.A/kg

According to the question:

⇒ {(45 × 3x) + (A × 2x)}/5x = 50

⇒ 135x + 2Ax = 50 × 5x

⇒ 135 + 2A = 250

⇒ 2A = 250 - 135 = 115

⇒ A = 115/2 = Rs.57.5/kg

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.57.5/kg**

questions.question: What is the radius of circle which circumscribes the triangle ABC whose sides are 16, 30, 34 units, respectively?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Triangle first side (a) = 16 units

Triangle second side (b) = 30 units

Triangle third side (c) = 34 units

**Formula used:**

Heron's formula:

Area of triangle = √{s × (s - a) × (s - b) × (s - c)}

Where, semi - perimeter (s) = (a + b + c)/2

and a, b and c are the sides of a triangle.

Circum-radius of a triangle = (a × b × c)/(4 × area of triangle)

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cd426e4af427cd255df3dfc9af12c29c00c607b8a66a81a9bffeb76d5cc252a.png] 

Semi - perimeter = (16 + 30 + 34)/2 = 80/2 = 40 units

Area of triangle = √{s × (s - a) × (s - b) × (s - c)}

⇒ √{40 × (40 - 16) × (40 - 30) × (40 - 34)}

⇒ √{40 × 24 × 10 × 6} = √57600 = 240 unit²

Circum-radius of a triangle = (a × b × c)/(4 × area of triangle)

⇒ (16 × 30 × 34)/(4 × 240) = 17 units

∴ The correct answer is 17 units.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Calculation:

The sides of a triangle given are Pythagorean triples.

So the hypotenuse = 34 units

and the circumradius of right angled triangle = 34/2 = 17 units

questions.question:
How many of the following numbers are divisible by 132?

660, 754, 924, 1452, 1526, 1980, 2045 and 2170
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

132 = 11 × 3 × 4

The number which is divisible by 132 should also be a multiple of 11, 3, and 4.

660 = 11 × 2 × 3 × 2 × 5

So 660 is divisible by 132.

754 = 2 × 3 × 109

So 754 is not divisible by 132.

924 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 11 × 7

So 924 is divisible by 132.

1452 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 11 × 11

1452 is divisible by 132.

1526 = 2 × 7 × 109

1526 is not divisible by 132.

1980 = 2 × 11 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 5

1980 is divisible by 132.

2045 = 5 × 409

2045 is not divisible by 132.

2170 = 2 × 7 × 5 × 31

2170 is not divisible by 132.

**∴ The correct option is 4.**

questions.question: In a constituency, 90% of the total number of people on the electoral roll cast their votes during an election. 15% of the votes cast were declared invalid. Jeeta secured 60% of the valid votes. If Jeeta secured 91,800 valid votes, what was the total number of people on the electoral roll?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total votes cast = 90% × the total number of people on the electoral roll

Invalid votes = 15% × the votes cast at the election centre

Jeeta got 60% × valid votes

Jeeta got 91,800 valid votes

**Calculation:**

Let, the total number of people on the electoral roll = 100x

Total votes cast = 100x × 90% = 90x

Valid votes = 90x × 85%

According to the question:

⇒ 90x × 85% × 60% = 91800

⇒ 90x = (91800 × 100 × 10)/(85 × 6)

⇒ x = (180 × 100 × 10)/90

⇒ x = 2000

The total number of people on the electoral roll = 100x

⇒ 100 × 2000 = 200000 people

**∴ The correct answer is 200000.**

questions.solution:

Radius of circle = 5 cm

The angle subtended by a sector on the centre = 60°

**Formula used:**

Area of sector = (π × R² × θ)/360°

**Calculation:**

Area of sector = (π × R2 × θ)/360°

⇒ (22/7) × (5)2 × 60°/360°

⇒ (22 × 25)/(7 × 6)

⇒ (11 × 25)/21 = 13.09 ≈ 13.1 cm²

A constable Ram is 225 m behind a thief Somesh. Ram runs 50 m and Somesh runs 30 m in a minute. At what time will the constable Ram catch the thief Somesh?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance between Ram and Somesh = 225 m

Speed of Ram = (50/60) = (5/6) m/s

Speed of Somesh = (30/60) = (1/2) m/s

**Formula used:**

Distance = relative speed × time

**Calculation:**

Distance = relative speed × time

⇒ 225 = {(5/6) - (1/2)} × time

⇒ 225 = {(5 - 3)/6} × time

⇒ Time = (225 × 6)/2 = 225 × 3

⇒ Time = 675 sec = 11 minutes 15 sec

**∴ The correct answer is 11 minutes 15 sec.**

questions.question: A man is walking at a speed of 14 km/h. After every km, he takes rest for 7 minutes. How much time will he take to cover a distance of 7 km?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of man = 14 km/h

Total distance to cover = 7 km

**Formula used:**

Time = distance/speed

**Calculation:**

If the man doesn't stop to rest, then

Time taken to complete the distance of 7 km = 7/14 = 1/2 h = 30 min

Total rest time = 7 × 6 = 42 min

Total time to cover the distance = 30 + 42 = 72 min = 1(1)/(5) hours

**∴ The correct answer is 1(1)/(5) h.**
